verdicts.reason: Both are broken in the same way. The background shrank to a narrow column in the middle and leaves white space on both sides. The white headline runs off onto that white space and becomes invisible, so only 'Devot', 'onal Da' and 'sts' can be read. The 'March 21' date is tiny and almost invisible, the subhead, quote and URL are gone, and a single divider line floats alone on the right. The only difference is the height of that divider (lower in A, higher in B), which doesn't make either one better.
